description: This file implements Metal graphics state cache management for the ANGLE project, including classes and functions for creating, caching, and managing Metal pipeline states, depth stencil states, and sampler states, with conversions from ANGLE-specific descriptors to Metal objects.

classes.name: StateCache
classes.description: Caches Metal depth stencil, sampler, and pipeline states to optimize Metal resource creation.

classes.name: RenderPipelineCache
classes.description: Manages and caches Metal render pipeline states based on pipeline descriptions.

classes.name: RenderPassDesc
classes.description: Describes a Metal render pass configuration, including attachments and formats.

classes.name: DepthStencilDesc
classes.description: Describes depth and stencil state configurations for Metal.

classes.name: SamplerDesc
classes.description: Describes sampler state configurations for Metal.

classes.name: BlendDesc
classes.description: Describes blending state configurations for Metal.

methods.name: ToObjC
methods.description: Converts ANGLE descriptors to Metal Objective-C objects.

methods.name: getDepthStencilState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Metal depth stencil state based on a descriptor.

methods.name: getSamplerState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Metal sampler state based on a descriptor.

methods.name: getNullDepthStencilState
methods.description: Returns a null (disabled) depth stencil state.
